title: Kennesaw State University
description: Kennesaw State University's official 2025 logo and colour guidelines define the primary colours Gold, Pantone 123C (#FFC629), Black (#000000), Pantone 421C (#B0B3B2) and White (#FFFFFF), and the secondary colours Pantone 348C (#00843D), Pantone 2655C (#A682EB), Pantone 715C (#F5873D), Pantone 284C (#66ABFF) and Pantone 803C (#FFFF00).
